candidates.transcript_evidence: Okay, so do you yourself know any other common hand signs or gestures that might have a unique meaning in other cultures?
candidates.description: 询问对方是否了解其他文化中有独特含义的手势

candidates.transcript_evidence: Yeah. Yeah. To be fair, I'm Egyptian, and, like, when we snap fingers, it just means, like, a speed up sort of thing.
candidates.description: 提及自己是埃及人，并说明打响指表示加快速度

candidates.transcript_evidence: I guess something someone mentioned was because, so, like, I was talking to someone before, and they're from China, and they're, like, when they came here, and they found out that, you know when you, like, you throw up, like, this or this, they have it from China.
candidates.description: 转述与中国朋友的交流，提及某些手势在中国和本地含义不同

candidates.transcript_evidence: They have it from meetings over here, right? One's offensive, one's normal.
candidates.description: 评价同一手势在当地有冒犯性和正常两种含义

candidates.transcript_evidence: That's, like, a UK-only thing. Because for them, each sign just means the same thing.
candidates.description: 说明该手势差异在英国本地特有，对中国人而言每个手势含义一致

candidates.transcript_evidence: So when they came here, they were, like, shit, that's a bit, you know, dodgy about it.
candidates.description: 转述中国朋友来英国后发现手势的意外反应

candidates.transcript_evidence: Okay, but have you yourself ever, like, experienced or witnessed a situation where, you know, a difference in cultures meant that a hand sign led to a misunderstanding?
candidates.description: 询问对方是否亲身经历或目睹过因文化差异导致手势误解的情况

candidates.transcript_evidence: I mean, not really. Because to be fair, right, back home in Egypt or whatever, we're so used to, like, Western stuff that we know, you know, we're used to, like, Western things. what their hand signs mean.
candidates.description: 表示并未经历过此类误解，因为埃及人已熟悉西方手势含义

candidates.transcript_evidence: I guess the only difference is you're not supposed to point at someone with your finger. That's rude. You're supposed to point with the forehand.
candidates.description: 指出差异在于不应直接用手指指人，而应用手背指示

candidates.transcript_evidence: I guess that's about it. Inclined towards your right.
candidates.description: 概括仅此差异，并提及指向右侧

candidates.transcript_evidence: But I think, to be fair, that's because back in Egypt, because we're Muslim in it, so for us, the right hand is supposed to be the pure hand, and your left hand is the impure one.
candidates.description: 解释因穆斯林文化，埃及认为右手洁净、左手不洁

candidates.transcript_evidence: Yeah, but I don't think they have that here.
candidates.description: 评论当地可能没有此类禁忌

candidates.transcript_evidence: Yeah, because to have for us as well, it's considered to be like, you know, the hand that you wash yourself with, or something like that. So it's like the impure one.
candidates.description: 进一步说明左手因用于清洁被视为不洁

candidates.transcript_evidence: But, yeah, I mean, yeah, I don't mind being Wi-Fi.
But I can leave that to you guys to answer.

limitations: 转录中部分语句（如'I guess something someone mentioned...'）为间接引述他人经历，无法确定说话者归属。
部分片段（如'Yeah. Yeah.'、'Hmm. Hmm.'、'All right, that's fair.'）为简短反馈，语义贡献有限。
转录末尾（'They see as well... unless they're not.'）含歧义或非完整句子，难以提取明确语义候选。
